newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen in oil talks with Germany's Preussag.
newsitem.headline: Yemen in oil talks with Germany's Preussag.

text.p: Yemen's Ministry of Oil and Mineral Resources is holding talks in Sanaa with Germany's Preussag Energie on granting an oil concession, a ministry official said on Monday.
"The concession area is in sector S2 in the governorate of Shabwa," about 460 km (285 miles) to the southeast of the capital Sanaa, he told Reuters.

"A committee has been set up by the ministry and the company to come to a final agreement after the two parties signed a momorandum of understanding about the issue recently," he said, but did not give further details.
Saudi Arabia's Nimir Petroleum currently operates in Shabwa's block number 4 with an output of 2,000 barrels per day.
